classes.name: index
classes.reason: In _consume the consumer aborts further reads once probe.NS()-started exceeds budget_ns ('if budget_ns and probe.NS() - started > budget_ns: return staged, True'), so each index file must be read within that time window, and each specific index path is read exactly once by the consumer per unit; only the consumer rank waits on that read, per the writer/reader independence rule.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops STATISTICS_READS (8) times over the same statistics paths calling probe.read_staged synchronously with no time check, so the consumer rank blocks on each of the 8 reads of the same file with no deadline, and only that consumer rank waits (the producer that wrote it is unaffected).
